title: NumericDate integers
description: Restates HCERT Specification, 3.2.5 Expiration Time; HCERT Specification, 3.2.6 Issued At; RFC 8392 CBOR Web Token (CWT).

statements.label: NumericDate integers
statements.requirement: iat and exp SHALL be encoded as integer NumericDate (seconds since the epoch). The decoder SHOULD accept floating-point NumericDate and truncate it.

sources.quote: SHALL hold a timestamp in the integer NumericDate format
